notes.title: 2025.01.16 HotFix
notes.content:
[UX]
The difficulty selection related UX has been updated.

[Localizing]
Fixed an issue where some text translations were not functioning properly.

notes.title: 2025.01.15 Minor Update
notes.content:
- A difficulty system has been added, allowing difficulty selection.

- A job selection system has been added, allowing job selection.

- Several bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: 2024.12.18(KST) Update
notes.content:
[ UI/UX Improvements ]
- Improved UX to make it easier to identify current location on the minimap.
- Added arrow UX to indicate target when clicking to use a card.

[ Bug Fixes ]
- Fixed an issue where the popup couldn't be closed when using the whirlwind potion.
- Fixed missing translations for some text.

notes.content:
